heading: T_retract without TMS
text:
### T_retract without TMS [LNOG.5.1]

The T_retract formula of [RTCT.12.2] under `logical: false`:

```
T_retract(fact) = c_wm_remove
                + c_dlheap × log N_ttl          (if fact had TTL; dynamic_ttl)
                + c_fifo                         (if fact had TTL; default FIFO)
                + c_alpha × A_s                 (alpha mem remove)
                + c_beta_ridx × joined × k      (ridx-based retract)
                                                 ← c_tms × n_ids term absent
```

The `c_tms × n_ids` term is dropped entirely.  No cascade depth
multiplier applies.
